description: This file defines the 'Classifier' interface, which includes an inner class 'Recognition'. It outlines methods for image recognition, statistical logging, and resource management, used within an Android application for visual recognition tasks.

classes.name: Classifier
classes.description: An interface defining methods for image classification and recognition, including an inner class for recognition results.

classes.name: Recognition
classes.description: A class representing a single recognition result, including its ID, title, confidence score, and location within the image.

methods.name: recognizeImage
methods.description: Performs image recognition on the provided Bitmap and returns a list of recognition results.

methods.name: enableStatLogging
methods.description: Enables or disables statistical logging related to the recognition process.

methods.name: getStatString
methods.description: Retrieves the current statistical information as a string.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources held by the classifier.
